sentences.en: The production of polyketides in heterologous hosts offers many advantages over the use of natural producers.

sentences.en: However, the knowledge out of this work can be applied for the heterologous production of other valuable terpenoid drugs like the mentioned artemisinin or paclitaxel.Sentencedict.com
